protocol.question: Do simple ETF ranking signals remain competitive with daily equal weighting after stated transaction costs across several development periods?
protocol.selection_notes: Rank by highest worst-window net excess return, then highest mean-window net excess return, then lexicographically smallest candidate ID. Retain every candidate even if all excess returns are negative. Do not retune after the single holdout evaluation.
protocol.universe_notes: Eight named, long-lived ETFs chosen by asset category, not observed backtest performance. Fixed research universe does not establish point-in-time membership or freedom from survivorship bias.
protocol.execution_notes: Signals after t close trade at t+1 close and realize returns through t+2 close. Top two are equally weighted daily; the equal-weight benchmark rebalances daily across all eight. Each evaluation window starts from cash and pays entry costs.
protocol.qwen_comparison: not_run; a future Agent comparison must use a newly frozen protocol and an unopened final interval
